conditions.description: Standard eligibility and admissibility conditions apply as described in General Annex B; participation is not restricted. Two topic-level exceptions apply (JRC participation and mandatory Copernicus/Galileo use).
conditions.source_section: Eligibility conditions (eligibility_restrictions; WP Part 9 General Annex B)

conditions.description: The Joint Research Centre may participate as a beneficiary with zero funding or as an associated partner, and does not participate in the preparation and submission of the proposal.

Where the project uses satellite-based earth observation, positioning, navigation or related timing data and services, beneficiaries must make use of Copernicus and/or Galileo/EGNOS. This is an eligibility condition, not a preference.
Technical capabilities and use cases must span terrestrial, freshwater and marine ecosystems in Member States and Associated Countries.
